articles.title: Microsoft Copilot reveals secret input that allowed it to be hacked
articles.content: Secret parameter allowed hackers to steal passwords when a target clicked on a link.

articles.content: After collaborating with 8BitDo on a gamepad two years ago, Genki launched the first controller the company designed from the ground up today. articles.title: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
articles.content: Google will soon allow you to customize your Discover feed by describing what you want to see. The new feature, rolling out to the Google app in the "coming days," will use AI to automatically tweak your feed and "remember" your preferences for future visits. You'll find the option within the three-dot menu on your […]
